entries.scope: Constrain npm agent version probes to code-owned commands and arguments in both maintenance scripts
entries.rationale: Untrusted registry command and arguments previously reached process execution in comparison, preview and normal modes.
readerPaths: npm agent registry -> maintenance scripts -> security boundary record
entries.navigationImpact: Existing maintenance documentation family; no top-level navigation change.
entries.languageStrategy: Complete German first, equivalent English second; CEFR B2 and applicable WCAG 2.2 AA criteria.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Controlled negative reproduction before and after; canonical probes, missing tool fallback and focused Bash and PowerShell tests. Practical screen-reader and Braille checks not repeated.
entries.risk: Package names and other registry fields remain a separate trust boundary for review; no blanket alert dismissal or risk acceptance.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Registry, probe contract, caller or distributed script changes.
